jobs.title: Chief of Staff, CEO
jobs.description:
Pendo is seeking a strategic, proactive Chief of Staff to serve as a trusted advisor and partner to our CEO. This highly visible role will help shape and advance company priorities, drive cross-functional alignment, and enable effective decision-making across the executive team. The ideal candidate is a sharp, analytical thinker who thrives in complexity, brings clarity to ambiguous situations, and moves seamlessly between strategy and execution. You’ll bring an independent and balanced point of view, build trusted relationships across the organization, and help translate the CEO’s and executive team’s priorities into meaningful business outcomes.

This role is based in our Raleigh office and requires travel.

What this looks like day-to-day

Honestly, there is no day-to-day for this job -- that’s the point. We’re looking for a heat-seeking missile to direct at the company’s hardest problems. Yes, you’ll be a member of our C-team helping to maximize our team’s entire effectiveness including our strategy planning, goal-setting, etc. We’re not looking for a facilitator or agenda-creator. We’re looking for someone who can synthesize data, form opinions and tackle problems with minimal supervision.

- Strategic planning and operating cadence: Drive the company’s strategic planning and operating rhythm, including annual thematic goals and quarterly OKRs. Partner with executive leaders and program owners to establish priorities, track progress, and surface issues requiring leadership attention.

- Tackle the hard problems: Take on complex, high-impact problems with minimal direction. Identify root causes, bring together the right perspectives to shape the path forward, and drive the work to a measurable outcome.

- Turn executive priorities into measurable results: Translate critical priorities into coordinated action across the organization. Mobilize the right leaders, remove obstacles, establish accountability, and sustain momentum through delivery.

- Executive and board communications: Develop high-quality narratives and materials for board, investor, executive, and other high-stakes meetings. Distill complex information into clear, compelling communication tailored to the audience and desired outcome.

- Leadership meetings and offsites: Lead executive team meetings and offsites in close partnership with the CEO. Shape agendas around the highest-leverage business issues and facilitate focused discussion, debate, and decision-making.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Chiefs of Staff don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

- Progressive experience in a technology, top-tier consulting, investing, or another high-performance environment.

- Experience partnering directly with a founder, CEO, or senior executive and personally owning enterprise-level initiatives from strategy through implementation.

- A track record of delivering measurable cross-functional business outcomes across complex, senior-stakeholder environments.

- Strong understanding of how product, go-to-market, customer experience, finance, and operations work together.

- Exceptional strategic judgment and analytical ability, including the ability to make sound recommendations with incomplete information.

- Executive presence with the ability to influence, align, and constructively challenge senior stakeholders.

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to produce decision-ready presentations and board materials.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience across multiple company stages, from early growth through scaled operations.

- A combination of consulting, investing, or strategy experience and hands-on operating leadership.

- Experience with enterprise transformation, operating-model design, product-led growth, or multi-product SaaS.

About Pendo

Pendo was founded in 2013 by former product managers, who combined their heads and hearts to build something they wanted but never had as product managers: a simple way to understand and attack what truly drives product success. Our mission is to improve society's experience with software. Come join one of the fastest-growing startups, supported by best-in-class institutions like Battery Ventures, Salesforce Ventures, Spark Capital and Meritech.

Pendo Core Values: Bias to Act, Hone Your Craft, The Team is Pendo, and Maniacal Focus.

Location: Pendo is a hybrid culture. In-office 3 days per week unless designated remote.

Compensation: The expected salary range for this role to be performed in Raleigh, NC is USD $203,000 - USD $244,000 base plus a bonus target and equity

Benefits: Pendo offers highly competitive, employer-heavy coverage in the United States, including $0 premium options, strong 401(k) match, equity, and flexible time off.

EEOC: We are an equal opportunity employer and believe having diverse teams where everyone brings their whole self to Pendo is key to our success. We welcome all people of different backgrounds, experiences, abilities and perspectives.

Accessibility: Pendo is committed to working with, and providing access and reasonable accommodation to, applicants with mental and/or physical disabilities. If you think you may require an accommodation for any part of the recruitment process, please send a request to: accommodation@pendo.io. All requests for accommodations are treated discreetly and confidentially, as practical and permitted by law.

jobs.title: Sr. GRC Engineer
jobs.description:
Sr. GRC Engineer

The Team + The Role

Pendo's Information Security team protects the data entrusted to Pendo and helps ensure our products are built with security and privacy by design. The team spans Security Operations, Product Security, and Compliance and Risk. With a small team and broad scope, the work directly supports the security, resilience, and trust of Pendo's products and operations.

The Sr. GRC Engineer is an AI-first technical leader who helps drive the evolution of Pendo's governance, risk, and compliance program. This role independently leads complex compliance, risk, and incident-response work while identifying program maturity gaps, translating security risk into business terms, and contributing to security roadmap and investment decisions. Success means building durable controls and programs that reduce risk and operational friction, not simply completing audits.

This role is based in our Raleigh office.

What this looks like day-to-day

- AI-driven compliance and operations acceleration: Use AI to accelerate audit evidence preparation, policy documentation, control testing workflows, and regulatory research. Evaluate GRC platform automation capabilities and integrate AI tooling where it reduces manual overhead, then document and share effective approaches with the team.

- Security program strategy and roadmap: Identify maturity gaps across compliance and security operations and translate them into prioritized roadmap recommendations grounded in business risk. Contribute to security investment discussions, clarify tradeoffs between coverage, cost, and risk, and anticipate emerging regulatory requirements before they become audit findings.

- Compliance program ownership: Own one or more regulatory compliance programs end-to-end, including SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001/42001, PCI-DSS, GovRAMP, or FedRAMP. Lead control design, evidence collection, auditor relationships, and remediation tracking to maintain effective and durable compliance programs.

- Risk assessment and prioritization: Conduct organizational risk assessments and present findings to leadership with clear prioritization and investment-level recommendations. Translate technical exposure into business-risk language that enables leaders to make informed decisions without requiring additional security interpretation.

- Incident response leadership: Lead incident response for complex, multi-system security events from investigation through resolution. Conduct root cause analysis, run post-incident reviews, and own resulting actions that turn incident findings into measurable program improvements.

- Cross-functional partnership: Work directly with engineering, product, and IT teams to deliver compliance requirements, validate implementations, and embed security into day-to-day operations. Translate compliance obligations into actionable technical requirements and influence how partner teams approach security as well as what they deliver.

Who You Are

Beyond the qualifications, we hire through a specific lens. These aren't buzzwords; they're the things we'll actually look for in how you talk about your work.

You're a builder, not a maintainer.

You're most energized when there isn't a clear path yet, and you get to define it. You don't wait for direction; you identify gaps, shape solutions, and drive them forward. At Pendo, great Sr. GRC Engineers don't just follow instructions; they operate as strategic advisors, influencing decisions, guiding stakeholders, and elevating how we work.

You're AI-curious - genuinely.

You're not using AI tools occasionally. You're rewiring how you work around them. You're faster, sharper, and more prolific because of it, and you bring that energy to everything — how you approach your work, how you prep, how you communicate, how you think. We want someone who sees AI as a multiplier, not a shortcut.

Must-haves

- 3 to 5 years of hands-on security experience with demonstrated ownership of compliance programs or security operations work, rather than participation alone.

- Deep working knowledge of at least two of the following frameworks: SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, FedRAMP, GovRAMP, or the NIST 800-series.

- Demonstrated ability to independently own auditor relationships and manage an audit cycle end-to-end, including responding directly to auditor questions.

- Experience leading incident response investigations from triage through root cause analysis and producing post-incident documentation that engineering teams can act on.

- Demonstrated ability to translate security risk into business-risk language that enables leaders to make investment and prioritization decisions.

- Active, demonstrated use of AI tools to accelerate security workflows such as evidence collection, policy drafting, regulatory research, or detection analysis.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor recommendations effectively for engineering, auditor, and leadership audiences.

Nice-to-haves

- Experience with SIEM or EDR platforms such as Splunk, Elastic, CrowdStrike, or SentinelOne, including independently writing and tuning detection rules.

- GRC platform administration experience with tools such as Vanta, Drata, or Archer, including automation configuration and third-party integrations.

- Experience operationalizing threat intelligence or conducting threat hunting using MITRE ATT&CK.

- A security certification such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, Security+, or equivalent.

- Experience working in a SaaS company with concurrent multi-framework compliance obligations.

jobs.title: VP, Growth Marketing
jobs.location: Remote / San Francisco, CA / New York, NY / Raleigh, NC
jobs.description:
The Team + The Role

Pendo’s Growth Marketing team owns the engine that creates predictable, efficient demand across paid, organic, lifecycle, and product-led channels. The team connects marketing strategy, analytics, experimentation, and cross-functional execution to generate qualified pipeline and improve the buyer and user journey.

As VP, Growth Marketing, you will lead Pendo’s full growth engine from top-of-funnel awareness through qualified pipeline creation. You will own demand generation, website performance, marketing analytics, experimentation, lifecycle programs, and product-led growth motions while partnering closely with Sales, Product, the CMO, the CRO, and the executive team.

Remote in the United States

What this looks like day-to-day

- Demand generation and pipeline: Own demand generation strategy and execution across paid search, paid social, SEO/GEO, content-driven acquisition, and multi-channel campaigns. Build programs that generate qualified pipeline and improve the efficiency and predictability of growth.

- Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with Sales on pipeline handoff and conversion, with Product on growth features and activation, and with the CMO and CRO on GTM priorities and investment allocation. Bring a clear growth point of view to executive and operator-level decisions.

- Marketing website performance: Own the marketing website as a core growth asset, including performance, conversion rate optimization, experimentation, lead routing, and continuous improvement of the buyer journey and demo experience. Partner with the CMO, VP of Product Marketing, and design team on UX/UI elements and product page content.

- Paid creative strategy: Bring a strong point of view on paid creative and partner with the broader marketing team on evergreen paid assets and integrated campaign assets. Ensure the team tracks creative performance and understands why each asset wins or loses.

- Experimentation system: Establish a rigorous testing culture across acquisition, the website, onboarding, and lifecycle. Identify what works, scale successful tests, and create a system for continuous improvement.

- Team leadership: Build, lead, and develop a high-performing growth organization across demand generation, performance marketing, SEO/GEO, website, analytics, and product/lifecycle growth. Create a team culture defined by ownership, pace, measurement, and cross-functional alignment.

- Proven track record owning demand generation across paid search, paid social, SEO, pipeline generation, and other growth channels, with measurable pipeline and revenue outcomes at scale.
